prompt.project_info: Create a candid 1990s disposable-camera-style flash snapshot in a crowded Japanese izakaya.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman seated on a wooden bar stool, turning slightly toward the camera with a gentle confident smile, wearing a white button-up shirt and opaque knee-length checkered skirt.
prompt.composition_elements: Tight spontaneous frame, subject looking toward the flash, handwritten menus and old posters, wood textures, older patrons softly out of focus, direct flash highlights and natural imperfection.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct on-camera flash creates bright highlights and hard shadows in a dim crowded izakaya, with warm nostalgic grain and close personal-memory atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:3 disposable-camera look, direct flash, slight motion softness, natural skin texture, high contrast, realistic film grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A candid flash snapshot of an approved adult woman sitting on a wooden bar stool in a small crowded Japanese izakaya. She turns slightly toward the camera with a gentle confident smile and wears a white button-up shirt and an opaque knee-length checkered skirt. The background is dim and crowded with handwritten menus, old posters, wooden textures, and patrons in dark clothes kept softly out of focus. Use direct on-camera flash with bright highlights, hard shadows, slight blur, natural imperfections, 1990s Japanese disposable-camera photography, warm nostalgic grain, and a tight spontaneous composition.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, short skirt, exposed underwear, suggestive gaze, sexualized pose, sharp background faces, readable logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
